channel.title: IREP Protocol
channel.description: The Individual-Referential Evaluation Protocol: an open standard for category-blind, trajectory-rich assessment in hiring and admissions. A commons, stewarded by Barkley Labs.

item.title: EU AI Act wording aligned with the Digital Omnibus
item.description: Annex III classification is unchanged; the obligations now apply from 2 December 2027. IREP's rule does not depend on that timeline: AI may assist, humans decide.

item.title: Become IREP: the recruiter on-ramp
item.description: Three self-declared paths, Starter, Aligned and Steward, with a starter guide and a badge kit. No certifier, no fee.

item.title: IREP v0.1, draft for public comment
item.description: The specification, its evidence base and a runnable Stage 0 demonstration. Specification CC BY 4.0, demonstration code Apache-2.0.
